intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The computer lab at 2 a.m. One monitor glows. Someone is reading a 1,400-page book for fun.

hello.speaker: cpp
hello.text: You're {player}? I'm Ciel. I don't do small talk. I do zero-cost abstractions.

ask.speaker: cpp
ask.text: Who should be in charge of memory?

control.speaker: cpp
control.text: Bold. I like that. Let's see if you can handle input and output.

gc.speaker: cpp
gc.text: Go date Julian, then. ...Unless you want to prove me wrong.

bye.speaker: cpp
bye.text: Fine. I'll still be here when you segfault your way back.
